A large part of this role is staying in regular contact with customer representatives, internal teams, and field engineers across assigned projects.
cond_0087.responsibilities:
Travel to sites for surveys and project-related meetings, connecting directly with customer and field personnel.
Prepare proposals based on site surveys, customer requests, and standards.
Select materials to meet project installation requirements.
Prepare detailed engineering and installation specifications.
Modify customer drawings and data for projects.
Provide regular status updates on assigned projects.
Ensure adherence to company and customer standards and practices.
Participate in quality activities for project engineering work.
Interface directly and regularly with customer field, center, and central office engineers on scope and content of assigned projects.
Provide specific detail engineering information to customers for assigned projects.
Actively engage with customer inquiries to resolve technical issues, clarifying requirements and walking customers through solutions.
Serve as primary point of contact for the customer on projects executed by the team.
Act as technical leader on assigned projects, speaking up to address issues and bring the right people together to keep work on track.
Take measures as necessary to satisfy the needs of the customer in the best interests of both the customer and [Company name masked].
cond_0087.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.
Minimum of 5 years of relevant DC power plant engineering experience in a Central Office environment.
Central office DC power plant engineering experience including: with various original equipment manufacturers (ABB, Vertiv, Alpha); with various battery types (flooded, VRLA); with customer standards particularly AT&T and Verizon; with customer databases (PowerPro, AMPEERS, GeoLink, etc.); with Rectifiers, Controllers, Inverters, Converters, Batteries, Secondary distribution to BDFB/BDCBB.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to interface effectively with customers on a regular basis.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to work on multiple projects/tasks simultaneously.
Strong PC skills, especially in Microsoft Excel and Word. AutoCad is a plus.
Knowledge of telecommunications transport technologies and central office environments and standards is a plus.
Ability to travel regionally.
Must be flexible to take on additional projects and job duties when required.
Must be able to pass pre-employment screening that includes background and drug testing.
Must have a valid driver's license and a driving record that meets company requirements.

A large part of this role is staying in regular contact with customer representatives, internal teams, and field engineers across assigned projects.
cond_0573.responsibilities:
Travel to sites for surveys and project-related meetings, connecting directly with customer and field personnel.
Prepare proposals based on site surveys, customer requests, and standards.
Select materials to meet project installation requirements.
Prepare detailed engineering and installation specifications.
Modify customer drawings and data for projects.
Provide regular status updates on assigned projects.
Ensure adherence to company and customer standards and practices.
Participate in quality activities for project engineering work.
Interface directly and regularly with customer field, center, and central office engineers on scope and content of assigned projects.
Provide specific detail engineering information to customers for assigned projects.
Actively engage with customer inquiries to resolve technical issues, clarifying requirements and walking customers through solutions.
Serve as primary point of contact for the customer on projects executed by the team.
Act as technical leader on assigned projects, speaking up to address issues and bring the right people together to keep work on track.
Take measures as necessary to satisfy the needs of the customer in the best interests of both the customer and [Company name masked].
cond_0573.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.
Minimum of 5 years of relevant DC power plant engineering experience in a Central Office environment.
Central office DC power plant engineering experience including: with various original equipment manufacturers (ABB, Vertiv, Alpha); with various battery types (flooded, VRLA); with customer standards particularly AT&T and Verizon; with customer databases (PowerPro, AMPEERS, GeoLink, etc.); with Rectifiers, Controllers, Inverters, Converters, Batteries, Secondary distribution to BDFB/BDCBB.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to interface effectively with customers on a regular basis.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to work on multiple projects/tasks simultaneously.
Strong PC skills, especially in Microsoft Excel and Word. AutoCad is a plus.
Knowledge of telecommunications transport technologies and central office environments and standards is a plus.
Ability to travel regionally.
Must be flexible to take on additional projects and job duties when required.
Must be able to pass pre-employment screening that includes background and drug testing.
Must have a valid driver's license and a driving record that meets company requirements.
